title: fix(console): a missing public /f/:slug form renders the shared localized not-found state

_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgDFH4S5pR1C8YvYCWWsZfXx)_

Fixes #27756

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：访客打开一个不存在、未发布或已停用的公开表单链接 `/f/SLUG` 时，不再显示英文原文 "Failed to load form (404): 服务端原文"，改为显示控制台通用的「页面不存在」空状态（按会话语言显示，不带「返回」按钮）；其它加载失败显示本地化的「表单加载失败」横幅，不再回显服务端正文。
- 为什么改：非英文会话的访客会看到一句未翻译的英文报错，且内容含服务端消息；内部 `/forms/NAME` 路由已在 #27446 改为本地化空状态，公开路由需一致。
- 风险与回滚：只动 `FormPage.tsx` 的公开表单加载与错误渲染；未新增或修改任何 i18n 键；内部路由行为不变。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.tsx` 中 `loadPublicForm` 与 `PublicFormUnavailableError`、以及 `if (notFound && !loaded)` 里 `mode !== 'public'` 一处；再看测试 `FormPage.publicNotFound-27756.test.tsx`。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage.publicNotFound-27756.test.tsx`，预期 3 个用例全绿（zh 下 404 显示「页面不存在」、500 显示「表单加载失败」，页面均无英文）。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `loadPublicForm` threw `Failed to load form (STATUS): BODY` for every non-OK `GET /forms/:slug`, and the page rendered that string verbatim in its error banner to the anonymous visitor, in every session language, with the server's body in it.
- A 404 from the resolver now throws the module-private `FormNotFoundError` that #27446 added for the internal route (its constructor now takes the message, so each loader names its own subject). The resolver answers 404 for a slug that is unknown, unpublished or no longer anonymous; the page draws the console's shared not-found state with the `console.notFound.title` / `console.notFound.description` keys.
- **Go back on the public route:** omitted. The visitor is a guest who arrived from a shared link, often in a fresh tab, so `navigate(-1)` has no console page to return to and is either a dead button or leaves the site. The internal route keeps its Go back button unchanged.
- Every other non-OK answer throws a new module-private `PublicFormUnavailableError` (status kept for logs). The page keeps it in its own `publicUnavailable` flag and draws the error banner with the existing `form.errorLoading` key ("Error loading form" / zh 「表单加载失败」), translated at render. The response body is no longer read at all.
- No `@object-ui/i18n` key is added and no pack value changes (`Clause-②: no`). All ten packs already carry `console.notFound.*` and `form.errorLoading`.

## Tests

- New `ui/apps/console/src/components/FormPage.publicNotFound-27756.test.tsx`, at the real `/f/:slug` route with no provider wrapped around it:
  - zh, 404: the state shows the zh title and description, and the page body holds no Latin word;
  - en, 404: `Page not found`, no button at all, no `Failed to load form` and no server body text;
  - CONTROL, zh, 500: the banner shows 「表单加载失败」, no not-found state, and the page body holds no Latin word (so no server body).
- Ablation: with `FormPage.tsx` restored to the merge base `6d8372a8`, all 3 cases fail (`Unable to find an element by: [data-testid="form-not-found"]` twice, `[data-testid="form-load-failed"]` once). Restored from `HEAD`, the file's hash matched the HEAD blob (`b27577ca`).

<details><summary>Local runs (head 9390a5a0)</summary>

- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run apps/console/src/components/FormPage` (all `FormPage*` suites): Test Files 40 passed (40), Tests 369 passed (369).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console run type-check`: exit 0 (the console tsconfig includes `src`, so the new test is compiled).
- `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run scripts/`: Test Files 169 passed, 2 skipped (171).
- `pnpm check:new-line-citations` (ui): 0 new citations.
- `node scripts/check-sdui-manifest.mjs` and the rest of the `dispatch-gates --commands` list (33 families): exit 0 each, reconciled with `--ran` (33 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED).
- Before pushing, `ui/` was grepped for `Failed to load form`: the only source hit is the message `PublicFormUnavailableError` keeps for logging (plus the new test's own negative assertion). No existing test pinned the old text.

</details>

## Acceptance notes

- The public route's not-found description is the shared `console.notFound.description` ("The URL you followed does not match any view in this app."), reused as the card asks. It is accurate for a guest, though it speaks of "views"; a guest-specific line would be a new key and is not in this card's scope.

## Verification

In a zh-CN session, open `/_console/f/no_such_slug`: the page shows 「页面不存在」 and its description, with no button and no English text.
